summary: Verified R engine durability bug-fix. Backend pytest suite (16 tests across test_r_pipeline.py and test_csv_cleaner.py) all pass. GET /api/health returns r_available=true, packages_ok=true. Sleep pipeline (POST /api/analysis/run + GET /api/analysis/results), testthat suite, ANOVA/regression endpoints, and Universal CSV Cleaner (profile/suggest/apply) all work. Frontend: R engine status badge shows 'R engine online · v4.2.2', Run R Analysis renders all four figures (histogram, scatter, boxplot, correlation heatmap), Run tests shows 'All tests passed', and csv-cleaner-section renders.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean: /app/.Rprofile prepends /app/.Rlib and backend/.env sets R_LIBS_USER; Rscript invoked with cwd=/app so .Rprofile is honored. Consider documenting the durable R library requirement in README to avoid future regressions on pod resets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: R durable library at /app/.Rlib + /app/.Rprofile is the mechanism. If packages_ok ever becomes false again, verify /app/.Rlib still exists and backend/.env still has R_LIBS_USER=/app/.Rlib.
rca of the issue: Previously janitor (and sometimes tidyverse) were installed in /usr/lib/R/site-library, wiped on pod resets. Fix persists them in /app/.Rlib and loads via /app/.Rprofile + R_LIBS_USER env var.
